<!--
Ask the question. This is the right form even if you are not sure whether what
you are seeing is a bug — describing it as a question costs nothing, and it is
relabelled if it turns out to be one.

The headings are the shape every issue in this tracker takes. A question rarely
fills all of them, and leaving a heading's guidance in place is the expected
outcome rather than an omission.

Leave the origin marker off, for the reason the ordinary issue template gives.
-->

## Background

What you are trying to do, what you tried, and what you saw instead of the
answer you were looking for. Include the `kanban --version` output, your
operating system, and your terminal if the question is about behavior you are
seeing rather than about the project generally.

## Requirements

1. The question itself, in one sentence.

## Acceptance

<!-- Maintainer field: leave this blank. A question is answered rather than
built, and closes on the answer. -->

## Out of scope

- Anything you are deliberately not asking here. Leave this as it is if there
  is nothing.

## Related

- The documentation you read before asking, or an issue that looked close.
